title: Service Hours, Slot Lengths and Reminders — Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
Each visit type of **Specimen Collection Appointments** runs on its own service hours. The card below gives the slot length, the first and last start times, weekend availability, the time the patient should plan for, whether the patient must stay on site, the reminder lead time and the published lobby wait target.

| Visit type | Slot or arrival window (minutes) | Earliest start | Latest start | Saturday and Sunday appointments | Time to allow (minutes) | Must remain on site | Reminder sent (hours before start) | Lobby wait target (minutes) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Patient Service Center Walk-In Visit | 0 (no slots) | 06:30 | 16:30 | Offered | 15 | No | 0 (none) | 30 |
| Patient Service Center Scheduled Appointment | 15 | 06:30 | 16:30 | Offered | 15 | No | 24 | 15 |
| Fasting Priority Appointment | 15 | 06:30 | 09:30 | Offered | 15 | No | 24 | 10 |
| Timed Glucose Tolerance Collection | 180 | 07:00 | 10:00 | Not offered | 180 | Yes | 48 | 10 |
| Pediatric Collection Appointment | 30 | 08:00 | 15:30 | Not offered | 30 | No | 24 | 15 |
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit | 60 | 07:00 | 15:00 | Offered | 30 | No | 48 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Facility Bedside Collection Visit | 240 | 05:00 | 09:00 | Offered | 15 | No | 24 | 0 (not applicable) |

### Notes on the columns

- **Slot or arrival window** — the length of one bookable slot, or of the arrival window for a home or facility visit; 0 means the visit type has no slots.
- **Earliest / latest start** — the earliest and latest appointment (or walk-in) start time, local time of the site, 24-hour clock.
- **Saturday and Sunday appointments** — whether weekend appointments are offered for the visit type.
- **Time to allow** — the minutes the patient should plan to spend for the collection.
- **Must remain on site** — whether the patient must stay at the Patient Service Center for the whole timed collection.
- **Reminder** — the hours before the appointment start at which the reminder text and email are sent; 0 means no reminder.
- **Lobby wait target** — a published service goal, not a guarantee; 0 means it does not apply to the visit type.

### Illustrations (hypothetical start times)

- A Mobile In-Home Collection Visit has a 60-minute arrival window; a window starting at 15:00 is the last one of the day, and a 15:30 start is outside its hours.
- A Timed Glucose Tolerance Collection occupies 180 minutes, and the patient stays on site throughout; a 10:00 start is the latest offered.
- A Fasting Priority Appointment starting at 09:45 lies after its 09:30 latest start and is not offered.
